title: These chairs are comfortable for a molded chair
text:
These chairs are comfortable for a molded chair. These chairs are comfortable for a molded chair. The assembly was fairly easy, the only complaint is there are no pilot holes in the wooden legs. My husband had to put the screws in. I could have done it with a power drill, but it wasn't charged. oops!

They look classy.

product_metadata.title: Porthos Home Patricia Eames-Style Dining Chair (Set of 2), Orange
description: The Patricia Eames-style dining chairs add truly modern style to your home. Reminiscent of mid-century designers, these striking chairs are crafted using molded-plastic and durable beech wood, making them light-weight and stunning. Keep these as vintage accents in your home office, modern dining room, or Entertainment center.
